headline: New Zealand All Blacks Face Pressure Following Losses To Wales And England
seoTitle: Wales Beats All Blacks In Historic Rugby Match
metaDescription: The New Zealand All Blacks are under scrutiny following a historic loss to Wales and a significant defeat by England during the recent international tour.
aiSummaryBullets: Wales achieved their first victory against New Zealand since 1953, ending a 73-year winless streak.
England recently secured a five-try win against the All Blacks, leading to increased pressure on coach Rennie.
Players like Maro Itoje have stated that England's recent performance against the All Blacks should be viewed as a baseline for future matches.
aiContextParagraph: The New Zealand All Blacks have experienced a challenging period in international rugby following a series of high-profile defeats. Their tour began with a historic loss to Wales, marking the first time the Welsh team defeated New Zealand in 73 years, a result described by observers as a landmark achievement. Following this, the All Blacks faced further difficulty in a match against England, where they conceded five tries in a significant loss. Reports indicate that these results have placed the All Blacks' coaching staff under scrutiny. While the team fielded a full-strength squad for the England encounter, featuring veteran players like Beauden Barrett, they were unable to secure a victory. England team members have since suggested that their recent performance represents a standard to maintain rather than the peak of their current capabilities, as discussions regarding team development and coaching accountability continue.
whyItIsViral: The story is widely covered by five independent international news outlets due to the historic nature of the losses experienced by the All Blacks.
